perspectives.decision: NO-GO until exact modern routing, terminal no-op, old-CRD envtest, and conditional narrow CEL handling are specified and tested.
NO-GO until consumed-proof/absent-Lease compatibility and failedEpochRecovery exclusion are included without audit mutation.

consensus: The bounded test-first specification is sufficient to enter code. Release, import, preflight, and live mutation remain outside this pipeline and separately gated.
